data.name: Social Sense
data.description: A phantom thief's social sixth sense allows her to avoid danger in social situations and to act first when it breaks out. She receives a +%1 bonus on Sense Motive checks to avoid being surprised by a foe, on Bluff checks to surprise a foe, and on initiative checks for surprise rounds that involved Bluff and Sense Motive checks to determine surprise.|PhantomThiefSocialSenseBonus
